about.title: About PoolDocx
text: PoolDocx is located in Dickinson, TX and provides Premium Weekly Pool Maintenance and Pool Equipment Installation and Repair Services. We’re open Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM. You can reach us at (409) 209-4335, or use the Contact Us page.

PoolDocx was started in 2021 by Nate Diaz. Nate’s passion for pools started in early 2019 when he decided to add a hot tub on to his existing pool. Rather than hire a company to do the design and build, Nate took it upon himself. Everything from the initial CAD modeling, to the excavating, masonry, electrical, plumbing and final finishing work, was all completed without outside contractors. What started out as a project to satisfy a need, turned into a full blown passion for pools & spas.

In 2021, with over 16 years of General Management experience in the retail segment, Nate decided it was time to set out on his own and start his company. PoolDocx was born from this combined passion for pools and customer service.
